## Introduction

The preprocessing etc has already been performed here: 

https://github.com/karissa-b/2021_MPSIIIBvQ96-RNAseq-7dpfLarve

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)
library(readxl)

library(limma)
library(edgeR)
```


# read in data
```{r}
file = list.files("data/public data/GSE217196 zebrafishlarvae bulkRNAseq", 
           full.names = T)

x = file %>% 
  grep(pattern = "dge", value = T) %>% 
  readRDS()

toptables = file %>% 
  grep(pattern = "toptab", value = T) %>%
  readRDS

logcpm = file %>% 
  grep(pattern = "cpm", value = T) %>%
  readRDS
```


# Fry gene set testing on communities
## convert zf to human IDs 

the netcoloc communities are annoyayed to human gene names. Need to convert the zerbafish ones here. 

```{r}
zf2hs = homologene::homologene(
  inTax = "7955", # zebrafish
  outTax = "9606", # human
  x$genes$gene_name) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    gene_name = `7955`, hs_gene_name = `9606`
  )
```

## prep inputs
```{r}
# create the design matrix
design.ac <- model.matrix(~Genotype, data = x$samples %>% 
                            droplevels()) %>% # get rid of the unused factor levels
  set_colnames(gsub(colnames(.), pattern = "Genotype", replacement = ""))
            
# convert zf ids to hs symbols   
logcpm %<>% 
  as_tibble(
    rownames = "gene_id"
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    x$genes %>% 
      dplyr::select(gene_id, gene_name)
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-gene_id) %>% 
  dplyr::select(gene_name, colnames(x))

logcpm %<>% 
  left_join(zf2hs, relationship = "many-to-many") %>% 
  mutate(.mean = rowMeans(across(starts_with("AC")))) %>%
  group_by(hs_gene_name) %>%
  slice_max(.mean, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-.mean) %>% 
  na.omit %>% 
  column_to_rownames("hs_gene_name")

## communities
cluster.gprofiler.results <- 
  list.files(path = "data/results/adultchildsubtypes v2", 
             pattern = "gprofiler", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE) %>% 
  set_names(
    str_replace(., 
                pattern = "/gprofiler_analysis_results.csv",
                replacement = ""
    ) %>% 
      str_remove(
        pattern = paste0("data/results/adultchildsubtypes v2", "/")
      )
  ) %>%   
  map(read.csv) %>%
  imap(~ mutate(.x, comparison = .y))

network.genes.cluster.DLB <- 
  cluster.gprofiler.results$CD_1A_lyso_DLB %>% 
  dplyr::select(Cluster, genes) %>% 
  mutate(genes = str_split(genes, " ")) %>% 
  deframe()
```

## run FRY
```{r}
fry.DLB <- colnames(design.ac)[2] %>% 
 sapply(function(y) {
    logcpm %>% 
     dplyr::select(-gene_name) %>% 
      fry(
        index = network.genes.cluster.DLB,
        design = design.ac, 
        contrast = y, 
        sort = "mixed"
      ) %>% 
      rownames_to_column("pathway") %>% 
      as_tibble() %>% 
      mutate(coef = y)
  }, simplify = FALSE)
```

## export

```{r}
# export toptable
toptables$MPSIIIB %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    symbol = gene_name, logFC, pval = PValue, FDR, DE
  ) %>% 
  writexl::write_xlsx("data/public data/processed/GSE217196_toptable_lysoMPSIIIB_dr_bulkLarvae.xlsx")

# export fry object
fry.DLB$MPSIIIB %>% 
  saveRDS("data/public data/processed/GSE217196_fry_lysoMPSIIIB_dr_bulkLarvae.rds")
```
